appDescription: GMG collects place suggestions and group votes and saves multi-stop travel courses for friends, families and colleagues.

function.name: SHOW_MOAGIL_COURSE
function.description: Retrieve the saved GMG course and remaining stops and display the course screen.

function.name: GET_MOAGIL_VOTE_RESULT
function.description: Retrieve the GMG group voting result while keeping an ongoing secret ballot private.

function.name: RESUME_MOAGIL_COURSE
function.description: Open the next saved GMG stop for user review before sending the remaining course to the vehicle navigation.
